attempts.summary: Set up a nightly cron backup on node2 (02:00 daily) that tars /srv/inventory/data, ships it via SCP/SSH to node1 as a dated archive under /var/backups/inventory, and prunes archives older than 7 days on node1. Verified the pipeline end-to-end including retention pruning, then restarted both nodes one at a time, confirming changed boot identity and full recovery of services, cron config, SSH keys, and data on each.
